_spec.note: Observed daily maximum and minimum at one anchor station, from NCEI daily summaries. A day with no observation is absent rather than zero. Normals are the 1991 to 2020 period computed from the same record and shipped beside it.

normals.note: Each metric's cumulative total through each calendar day, as [mean, standard deviation] over the base period. Counts are days; rain is inches.
